description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class 'MaintenanceServiceTest' for testing the 'MaintenanceService' within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup for mocking dependencies, and contains multiple detailed test methods verifying data access and business logic related to employee maintenance features.

classes.name: MaintenanceServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of the MaintenanceService, including data retrieval and entity purging logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, setting up the MaintenanceService instance, test fixture, and mocking required services before each test.

methods.name: testAccessEmployeeData
methods.description: Verifies that the maintenanceService correctly retrieves and returns detailed employee data for employee ID 1, asserting the correctness of numerous fields.

methods.name: testReportTo
methods.description: Tests retrieval of report-to relationships within employee data.

methods.name: testEmpPicture
methods.description: Validates access to employee picture data.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee attachment data.

methods.name: testEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Checks the correctness of employee emergency contact data.

methods.name: testEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Validates access to employee immigration records.

methods.name: testEmpWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of employee work experiences.

methods.name: testEmpUsTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests US tax exemption details retrieval.

methods.name: testGetPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Validates retrieval of entities eligible for GDPR purge.

methods.name: testGetAccessStrategy
methods.description: Tests access strategy retrieval for different modules.
